The exact second-moment ratio follows from chi-square fourth moments; 52 independently coded exact rational moment contractions matched. A positive-probability angular neighborhood of a product-state maximizer and a single dominating sample match the lower coefficient. The proof handles all fixed m≥1, every nonzero finite-dimensional PSD H, r=0 separately, and the strict exponential-moment ranges; it does not classify the one-factor mgf endpoint.

value.rationale: The exact necessary-and-sufficient number of normalized factors to regain exponential integrability answers a natural outlier-design question in numerical Kronecker trace estimation, even for entangled PSD inputs. The invariant rho(H) distinguishes product-direction extremes from ordinary spectral norm, which is demonstrated by an exact Bell-projector example. Replacing a Gaussian factor by its scaled direction costs no additional rank-one matrix-vector oracle call and reduces all convex risks. Although general Gaussian-chaos scales and full spherical normalization are known, the exact hybrid threshold and coefficient provide a concrete reproducible diagnostic.
